summary.name: Rootly Blog
summary.one_liner: Rootly's blog index of articles on incident management, retrospectives, status pages, AI SRE tooling and reliability practice.
use_cases: prepare incident records for SOC 2 audits
run a status page during an incident
summary.what_it_does: This is the index page for the Rootly blog, listing recent posts on incident management, reliability and AI for SRE and platform teams. Topics include root cause analysis versus contributing-factors approaches, retrospective template design, status page practice, and SOC 2 incident record keeping. Other posts compare incident tools such as Datadog On-Call and PagerDuty, and assess AI SRE agents and AI-driven root cause analysis. Some engineering posts describe how Rootly built collaborative retrospectives with Y.js CRDTs and how its AI SRE correlates telemetry with deploys and feature-flag changes.
notable: Mixes practical incident guides with engineering stories about Rootly's own product internals
Includes vendor comparisons (Datadog On-Call vs PagerDuty) and an honest assessment of AI SRE agents
Covers AI SRE telemetry correlation with recent commits, deploys and feature flags
caveats: Blog index only; it does not describe pricing or product features in full, and posts are vendor-authored marketing content to some degree
